`npm test` passes: 3 of 3 tests in `test/login.test.tsx`.

LoginButtonBuggy ignores the first click because its handler only calls `setArmed(true)` and returns, so `onLogin` never runs. The `armed` check is evaluated against the value from the last render, and the second click is the first one that sees `armed === true` and calls `onLogin(mockLogin())`.

result:
`npm test` passes: 3 of 3 tests in `test/login.test.tsx`.

LoginButtonBuggy ignores the first click because its handler only calls `setArmed(true)` and returns, so `onLogin` never runs. The `armed` check is evaluated against the value from the last render, and the second click is the first one that sees `armed === true` and calls `onLogin(mockLogin())`.
